title: Native Device MCP exact local consent parity and Windows build-profile correction

phases.objective: Verify opt-in, Staging-only, exact-identity local approval for bounded file/terminal actions and Windows environment checks while preserving an independent live Staging acceptance gate.

e2e_journeys.actor: OAuth-authenticated Native Device MCP client and local Windows consenting operator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Native MCP endpoint and independently authenticated loopback consent bridge
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Only a signed, correctly scoped device and tenant principal with exact one-shot Staging local consent can access bounded file or interactive operations. All unauthorized or Production mutation requests fail closed.
steps: Validate signed OAuth client scope, tenant/device binding and read/write separation.
Issue a one-shot exact-argument consent over the authenticated loopback endpoint and reject tunneled origins.
Invoke the approved MCP action, verify success, then reject replay, changed arguments and a different principal.
Reject Production environment, disabled broker and unauthorized operations; retain Staging live certification requirement.
assertions: No OAuth scope by itself authorizes sensitive file writes or interactive terminal input.
Consent is bound to exact principal, device, tool, arguments and one use within 90 seconds.
Forwarded/tunneled, mismatched identity and Production consents are denied.
Synthetic test success does not constitute live Windows Staging acceptance or Production promotion.

e2e_journeys.actor: Windows Local Manager builder and local Connector administrator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Windows local consent UI, build-time environment policy and governed installer
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Windows integration provides explicitly scoped local consent while invalid build profiles are blocked; Native Device MCP assets ship in the Connector staging distribution.
steps: Confirm Windows form exposes one-shot consent without persisting secrets or public fallback.
Require existing MSBuild production/staging environment check and reject the previously unreachable runtime comparison.
Check installer and safe-upgrade packaging include the approval broker.
Build isolated Windows Staging EXE separately before any live Staging deployment.
assertions: Staging and Production constants remain isolated and wrong profiles fail at build time.
Original local-connector approval secrets are not copied into MCP requests.
Installer distribution includes the exact Native MCP broker source.
Live Staging installation and OAuth pairing remain independently required; Production writes disabled.
